expectedLearning: Whether radical succession can become a canonical reader exemplar with exact native endpoints and no new runtime category.
Whether the resulting promotion kit makes unit-exponent adoption content-and-wiring work only.
allowedWork: Execute only the approved radical reader adoption and promotion-kit contract.
Preserve and verify native reader semantics, accessibility, responsive behavior, seek, rewind, export, and production closure.
